title: Students protest at IIIT Ranchi after student found dead
seoTitle: Ranchi IIIT students protest student death

tea.why: Students are protesting following the death of a first-year student and alleging institutional negligence and poor management.
tea.want: Students demand the resignation of the institute's director and improved emergency medical facilities on campus.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Students continued their protest for the second consecutive day as examinations were halted due to the agitation.

summary: Students at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) in Ranchi launched a protest after a first-year student was found dead in his hostel room. Demonstrators blocked the Khelgaon-Tatisilwai road and accused the administration of poor management, a lack of basic amenities, and the absence of proper emergency medical facilities such as an ambulance and a campus doctor. Protesters demanded the immediate resignation of the institute's director, Rajiv Srivastava. According to police, a case of unnatural death was registered and an investigation is ongoing. The institute chairperson visited the site to hold talks with the students, while examinations scheduled for Monday were disrupted.
demands: Resignation of institute director Rajiv Srivastava
Implementation of a round-the-clock emergency medical system
Permanent deployment of a campus doctor
response: Police stated an investigation is underway into the unnatural death. The institute chairperson visited the protest site to hold talks with students, while registrar Munuren Samson Champia noted that examinations could not be held due to the agitation.

deaths.text: a first-year student of the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) was found dead

updates.text: Students staged a protest outside a hostel and blocked a road after a first-year student was found dead.
Students continued their protest for the second consecutive day, demanding the director's resignation and better medical facilities.
